blocks.text: ILIGAN CITY – Hundreds of graduating senior high school students who aspire to become “Iskolar ng Bayan” trooped to the St. Michael’s Cathedral here on Saturday to have their pencils blessed by a priest a day before taking the System Admission and Scholarship Examination (SASE) of the Mindanao State University (MSU). The MSU-Iligan Institute of Technology campus is one of the testing centers for SASE where examinees take the competitive examination that will earn them slots in Mindanao’s premier state university.
